items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He and his brother Joe had an orchestra in Pittsburgh called the Elyte [phonetic] or Elite Serenaders. I had occasion to play with them once or twice.

ctx.x: One more artist who we just mentioned in passing, but maybe you can elaborate on a bit more, is Roy Eldridge.

Oh, Roy, I played with Roy in 1925. He and his brother Joe had an orchestra in Pittsburgh called the Elyte [phonetic] or Elite Serenaders. I had occasion to play with them once or twice. But he was an original.

items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I played for a very short while with Roy Eldridge and his brother, Joe. They had an orchestra called the Elite Serenaders

ctx.x: And then you say somewhere -- maybe in 1926 -- you ...

Yes. Well, actually, I played for a very short while with Roy Eldridge and his brother, Joe. They had an orchestra called the Elite Serenaders or Elite Syncopators, I don't know ... probably the Elite Serenaders.
And that was also in Pittsburgh?
